artworks.title: Protesilaus and Laodamia
artworks.description: Palagi's farewell — the wife who made an image of the captain the black earth held when he leapt first from his ship.

artworks.title: The Burning of the Greek Fleet
artworks.description: Fire on the shore — the ship that bore Protesilaus to Troy but never brought him home, landmark of the later battles for the wall.
